title: Police action against SFI: Pinarayi urges Mallikarjun Kharge to restrain Congress-led Keralam govt from ‘pandering to Sangh Parivar’
description: Opposition Leader says there was no provocation for police to resort to ‘violent lathicharge’ on students, who were peacefully protesting against full rendition of Vande Mataram in front of university building
